confidence_notes: I ran two web searches. One found the RBA rate. The other found Tallinn cost-of-living aggregates (crowd-sourced and partly dated, with wide ranges). The beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors come from those aggregates. I did not search mid-range meal, cocktail or wine prices. The mid-range meal is scaled from the inexpensive meal, and cocktail and wine are set from the usual local relationship to beer. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for the summer high season, not based on any booking pages or listings. The RBA observation is the latest I found (18 Nov 2026), not a July 2026 value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Riga and Vilnius, but Tallinn is somewhat pricier because of tourism demand, similar to a mid-priced Nordic-Baltic capital.
